integrity: Full proof and standalone finite checker included. No independent external audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for positive binary palindromes at gaps 2^k with integer k>=2; all other gaps and other bases excluded. Enumeration for k=2..14 supplements an unrestricted bit-reflection proof. Indexed search does not guarantee global uniqueness.
title: Exact powers-of-two gap multiplicities for binary palindromes
